title: Aqua Metals to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Host Investor Conference Call on November 16, 2026

# Press Releases


# Aqua Metals to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Host Investor Conference Call on November 16, 2026


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_d64767af86ac24e8ab48a51ee33dc67e/aqmetals/news/2026-11-09_Aqua_Metals_to_Announce_Third_Quarter_2026_347.pdf)


November 09, 2026


RENO, Nev., Nov. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Aqua Metals, Inc. (NASDAQ: AQMS), a pioneer in sustainable lithium battery recycling, today announced it will report financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, and provide a business update on Monday, November 16, 2026. Management will host a conference call that day at 4:30 p.m. ET.


The live conference call and replay can be accessed from the investor relations section of the Company’s website at[https://ir.aquametals.com/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=rU7yPH0Qp5cbfnNKO5Q81vUByPTEvoeMlStVz8C9Hmuxp2sB-SioeRiPCsLPAJXL6Y3XlJr8uYXbxGPrSabELf5m5-44pN7J6oZUEuKsRbk=) .


**About Aqua Metals**


Aqua Metals is advancing sustainable lithium battery recycling through its proprietary AquaRefining™ technology, an electro-hydrometallurgical process designed to recover critical battery materials using electricity rather than high-temperature processing. The Company is developing Project Headwaters as its first commercial-scale deployment focused on domestic recycling and refining of lithium-ion batteries and manufacturing scrap.
